**Finding: Deviation — no express performance warranty from HDI.**

- **Section 9 ("Warranties," p0055–p0058)** contains only mutual corporate reps (organization, authority, enforceability, no conflicts) and an HDI acknowledgement regarding the Globix Agreement.
- Sections 1 and 5 impose delivery obligations (e.g., §1.6 launch deadline backed by a termination right) but no workmanlike-performance standard, no conformance warranty for the Site, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and no repair/re-performance/refund remedy.
- No implied-warranty disclaimer exists, so this is not walk-away territory — but the total absence of an express performance warranty fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies).

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 giving the preferred position — workmanlike services, 12-month Site conformance to the specifications approved under §5.2, legal compliance, no malicious code — with a re-performance/repair/refund remedy, and the 90-day fallback offered in the comment.
